result.title: Visual Memory and Textual Alignment for Cross-Modal Few-Shot Segmentation
result.summary: Few-shot segmentation (FSS) aims to segment target objects with limited annotated examples. Recent studies have begun to explore large foundation models to improve generalization for this task. In particular, SAM 3 provides strong visual representations and supports text-guided segmentation. However, its performance remains limited in specialized domains, where semantic prompts and visual representations are often poorly aligned. To address this challenge, we propose ViTA-SAM, a framework built upon SAM 3 that integrates visual memory and textual features through cross-modal alignment. Specifically, we construct a visual memory module that encodes support features together with their corresponding masks, providing support-aware visual guidance for query prediction. In parallel, we leverage the text encoder of SAM 3 to extract semantic features as complementary priors. To bridge the gap between semantic and visual representations, we introduce a cross-modal alignment module that conditions textual features on memory-enhanced visual representations, yielding more consistent and visually grounded predictions. In addition, we propose a pseudo-label refinement strategy that updates the memory with predicted query masks, enabling query-adaptive representation learning. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that ViTA-SAM achieves the best overall performance among the compared methods, outperforming the strongest competing method by over 5% in average mIoU.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 ViTA-SAM：在 SAM 3 之上构建视觉记忆模块，将支持样本特征与掩码编码为支持感知的视觉引导，并以跨模态对齐模块把文本语义先验条件化到记忆增强的视觉表示上，再用伪标签精炼策略以预测掩码更新记忆，用于跨模态少样本分割。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「记忆读入—查询自适应更新」结构及用自身预测掩码做伪标签监督的机制，可能与 LVR 中 latent 状态的维持、迭代更新与监督来源存在可核查的方法线索；但论文任务是分割而非多模态推理，无显式推理状态生成，联系偏弱，需阅读正文确认是否具备可迁移的状态更新设计。
